# imagy.app

> > A free, browser-based image editing suite offering compression, conversion, cropping, resizing, and metadata analysis without requiring uploads or installation.

imagy.app provides essential image manipulation tools entirely in the browser, supporting multiple formats including PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF, BMP, TIFF, RAW, and more. Built with privacy-first principles and WebAssembly technology, the platform enables batch processing and quick edits for photographers, designers, and content creators.

## Key Topics

- Image compression
- Format conversion
- Image resizing
- Crop and split
- Aspect ratio
- EXIF metadata
- Browser-based
- Batch processing
- PNG, JPG, WebP
- Privacy-focused
- Free online tools
- No upload required
- WebAssembly
- Social media optimization
- Image dimensions

## Core Image Tools

- [Free Online Image Compressor](https://imagy.app/image-compressor): Reduce file size for JPEG, PNG, and WebP images while preserving quality
- [Free Online Image Converter](https://imagy.app/image-converter): Convert between all major image formats including JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP, and more
- [Image Resizer](https://imagy.app/image-resizer): Resize images to custom dimensions supporting JPG, PNG, TIFF, and RAW formats
- [Crop Your Images Online](https://imagy.app/crop-image-online): Free image cropping tool with batch processing for JPG, PNG, and WebP
- [Split Your Image Online](https://imagy.app/split-image): Split images vertically, horizontally, or into grids for social media and design projects

## Image Analysis & Adjustment

- [Image Aspect Ratio Changer](https://imagy.app/image-aspect-ratio-changer): Adjust aspect ratios for JPEG, PNG, and WebP with social media optimization presets
- [EXIF Data Viewer](https://imagy.app/exif-data-viewer): View and analyze image metadata including GPS location, camera settings, and EXIF data
- [Image Size Finder](https://imagy.app/image-size-finder): Check image dimensions, width, height, and file size across multiple formats
- [Aspect Ratio Calculator](https://imagy.app/aspect-ratio-calculator): Calculate aspect ratios for images and videos with standard preset dimensions
